english.title: Registered person contravene / fail to notify Commission of information re termination of pregnancy
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person registered with the Care Quality Commission carrying out a regulated activity consisting of the termination of pregnancies, namely **(..SPECIFY SERVICE NAME..), having received information concerning the death of a service user, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), who had undergone termination of a pregnancy during the period of 12 months ending on the date on which the information was received and having reason to believe that the service user's death may be associated with the termination, failed to give notice in writing to the Commission of that information, within the period of 14 days beginning on the day on which the information was received
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 20(10) and 25 of the Care Quality Commission (Registration) Regulations 2009.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The offence is not applicable to English NHS bodies.
(ii) Regulation 20(9)) states that the notice of the termination must be sent to the Chief Medical officer of the Department of Health.
(iii) Regulation 20(3) outlines the registered person must ensure the relevant certificate of proof is included within a service users medical record.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant was a person registered with the Care Quality Commission carrying out a regulated activity consisting of the termination of pregnancies, namely **(..SPECIFY SERVICE NAME..), having received information concerning the death of a service user, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), who had undergone termination of a pregnancy during the period of 12 months ending on the date on which the information was received and having reason to believe that the service user's death may be associated with the termination, failed to give notice in writing to the Commission of that information, within the period of 14 days beginning on the day on which the information was received.
